name: foundations-idp

notes: generate-check and e2e CI jobs use a kind cluster; their results are CI or local-runtime evidence, not live evidence.
Live cloud mutation needs a user-authorised boundary.

invariants: Never author cloud resources; everything is rendered from the Foundations pin by renderer/ and the generators.
Never hand-edit generated output; change the generator or renderer and regenerate.
Bump the Foundations pin in one PR and regenerate in the same PR.
Tenancy (namespace, repository, RepoSync) comes from the tenant System entity, never from template input.
Backstage has read-only cluster access; writes go through GitOps.
Secrets never enter Git; a skipped check is reported as skipped.
